LESSON: HADITH ON PLANTING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on dressing (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the lea
Topic 2.3: Hadith on planting
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hadith on planting, part of Hadith 2.2 Hadith on dressing (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the lea in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the dangers of cutting down trees? 2. What are the benefits of growing trees and crops?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hadith on planting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. assess the importance of planting trees and crops as an act of ibadah,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hadith on planting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hadith on planting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hadith on planting in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness,

   Hadith on planting helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. assess the importance of planting trees and crops as an act of ibadah,

   Hadith on planting helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah,

   Hadith on planting helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures.

   Hadith on planting helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read the Hadith on planting trees and crops: “If a Muslim plants a tree or sows a field and men, animals and birds eat from it, all of it is charity from him.” (Muslim),

2. research on the significance of planting trees and crops and present the findings in class,

3. collect pictures of fruit- bearing plants and crops and display in class,

4. plant trees and crops in the school compound and care for them. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read the Hadith on planting trees and crops: “If a Muslim plants a tree or sows a field and men, animals and birds eat from it, all of it is charity from him.” (Muslim),
2. research on the significance of planting trees and crops and present the findings in class,
3. collect pictures of fruit- bearing plants and crops and display in class,
4. plant trees and crops in the school compound and care for them. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hadith on planting together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problems solving: researching skill attained as learners research on the significance of planting

trees and crops.

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of making connections is enhanced as learners collect and display pictures of fruit- bearing trees.

Values:
Responsibility: Accountability achieved as learners plant and take care of trees and crops.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Socio Economic and environmental issues: Environmental education attained as learners plant and take care of trees.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Agriculture: it contains similar content on planting trees and crops.
